value.name: Asha uses mother's old name
value.description: Asha softly says the old childhood name her mother once used for her, trying to reach her mother through a familiar memory.
evidence: she said the old name softly, the one her mother had used when she was small enough to fit under one arm, the one no one else in the world had ever used for her

value.name: Mother recognizes the word
value.description: Asha watches for a response and sees her mother's eyes move toward her mouth, suggesting the name itself is what she recognizes.
evidence: She watched for the eyes to do something, anything, and they did move, slow over her mouth as if the shape of the word was the part being recognized rather than the woman saying it

value.name: Lucia enters quietly
value.description: Lucia slips into the room without speaking, avoiding direct engagement with Asha as she approaches the bedside table.
evidence: Behind her, Lucia eased into the room without speaking and reached past the chair for the water glass on the bedside table
her face kept toward the small task and away from her sister

value.name: Lucia tends the water glass
value.description: Lucia straightens the straw and turns the glass away from the pillow, performing a small caretaking gesture while avoiding Asha's gaze.
evidence: reached past the chair for the water glass on the bedside table, straightening the bent straw and turning the glass a quarter turn for no reason Asha could see
she set it down with the straw aimed away from the pillow

value.name: Asha senses sisterly avoidance
value.description: Asha notices Lucia's avoidance and understands that their unresolved conversation will have to begin elsewhere than at the bed.
evidence: Asha registered the avoidance without lifting her head
she understood, in the way she had been understanding things all evening, that whatever conversation they owed each other tonight was going to have to start from somewhere other than the bed

value.name: Asha releases mother's hand
value.description: Asha briefly holds her mother's hand, then lets go and stands up, testing whether the warmth of contact will remain.
evidence: Asha let her mother's hand settle back onto the blanket and held it there a moment with her own before drawing her fingers away, as if testing whether the warmth would follow
She stood, the chair giving a small creak under the shift of her weight

value.name: Asha turns to Lucia
value.description: After standing, Asha turns toward Lucia at the bedside table, initiating the next exchange between the sisters.
evidence: and turned toward Lucia at the bedside table

value.name: Lucia asks about updated reports
value.description: Without fully meeting Asha's eyes, Lucia asks whether she has seen the facility's updated reports from the previous week.
evidence: without quite meeting Asha's eyes, asked in a low voice whether Asha had seen the updated reports from the facility, the ones that had come in the week before
